constraints: Positive moveH/moveV move right/down respectively; negative move left/up.
By default, moveH/moveV/resizeH/resizeV are relative to the object's previous position; passing the trailing '*' makes them absolute instead.
If object is a name matched via the '@' wildcard against multiple objects, all matching objects are moved/resized.
Only functions in: input forms in entry mode, forms displayed via DIALOG, headers/footers of output forms displayed by MODIFY SELECTION/DISPLAY SELECTION, and form printing events.

params.name: moveH
params.description: Horizontal move, in pixels (>0 = right, <0 = left).

params.name: moveV
params.description: Vertical move, in pixels (>0 = down, <0 = up).

params.name: absolute
params.description: Trailing '*', independent of the leading one: if passed, moveH/moveV/resizeH/resizeV are absolute coordinates/size instead of relative deltas.

discriminatedBy.rule: When '*' is passed, object is an object name (Text) identifying the target by name; when '*' is omitted, object must be a direct Variable or Field reference.

interactionNotes.note: Two independent, non-mutually-exclusive '*' flags in the same call: the leading '*' selects how object is addressed (name string vs variable/field reference); the trailing '*' (renamed here to 'absolute' to disambiguate from the leading one, since the schema keys params by name) switches moveH/moveV/resizeH/resizeV from relative deltas to absolute coordinates/size.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Moves, and optionally resizes, the designated form object(s) in the current form, either relative to their previous position or (with the trailing '*') to absolute coordinates/size.
overloadMerges.note: Merged the leading-'*' dual signature into one overload with object as a Text/Variable,Field union discriminated by the leading '*'; kept the mechanically-separate trailing '*' as its own optional literal_symbols param ('absolute') since it is an unrelated, independently-optional flag documented on the same line, not a duplicate of the leading discriminator.
